title: shellBody reads powershell -Command, pwsh -c and cmd /c bodies for every guard
notes: Follow-up from #364: running-app-guard.ts now judges the body of powershell -Command / pwsh -c / cmd /c (//c from Git Bash) on its own; the shared shellBody in hook-answer.ts does not, so test-run-guard misses pwsh -c "pnpm test" and startsClaude in src/main/actions/pane/send.ts misses powershell -Command claude. Move the unwrapping into shellBody so every guard gets it, with a test per caller.
